About the Team
You'll join the Full Stack group within Cloud Services, which is being built now. Today, production and analytical workloads share a single database, and each product defines its own metrics. About the Role
Most data engineers early in their careers maintain one slice of a large, mature platform, or build pipelines against a model someone else designed years ago. This role is the opposite.
As an SDE II, Data Engineer, you'll be one of the first engineers building Gather AI's data foundation from scratch. The work includes:
Moving analytics off our production PostgreSQL database
Writing the layered dbt models every product will share
Defining metrics once so they stay consistent everywhere
Linking structured records back to the drone images and video they came from
You'll start by shipping well-scoped pipelines and models on our Drone product alongside senior engineers. From there, you'll grow toward owning a data domain end to end: its design, its quality, and its on-call.

What You'll Do
Build extraction pipelines. Move data from production PostgreSQL into the analytical warehouse (raw, refined, serving) using incremental loads that protect the production database.

Document your work. Keep models documented and registered in the data catalog.
Ship safely. Deliver through CI/CD, use AI-assisted development, and join on-call for the pipelines you own.
